rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not fetch or verify any order or product details, and did not confirm any order-changing actions before execution. In fact, it performed no return or exchange writes at all and only provided a single combined savings figure. It also failed to provide the separate savings amounts for each option (return-only vs exchange-only) as requested, nor did it handle the “if only one is possible, do the one that saves more” preference. The price figures used were unsupported by any tool calls, making them potentially fabricated. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
